circuit.name: CLLC Resonant DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Bidirectional isolated resonant DC-DC converter with complementary LLC tanks on primary and secondary sides. Converts 400V input to 400V output (unity-gain V2G demo). Primary full H-bridge (SW1-SW4) drives a series-resonant tank Cr_P-Lr through transformer T1. Secondary features an asymmetric topology: Cr_S in series from T1.S1, followed by secondary resonant inductor Ls which drives the right-side bridge (SW7-SW8), while the left-side bridge (SW5-SW6) is driven directly from T1.S2. This asymmetry allows independent control of power flow direction while maintaining ZVS/ZCS operation near the resonant frequency fr = 1/(2pi*sqrt(Lr*Cr_P)) ~ 100kHz on the primary side.

requirements.requirement: Output voltage regulation at 400V; verify unity-gain operation at resonant frequency
Primary and secondary resonant tank verification; Lr current should be sinusoidal at operating frequency; Ls current validates asymmetric secondary power path and bidirectional capability

plot.title: Primary Resonant Inductor Current (should be sinusoidal)

outputs.description: Peak primary resonant inductor current in amperes
RMS primary resonant inductor current in amperes
Peak secondary resonant inductor current (indicates right-bridge power)
Secondary resonant capacitor voltage swing (asymmetric tank stress indicator)

requirements.requirement: Efficiency at unity-gain operating point; ZVS/ZCS expected at resonant frequency
